Ameen Rihani, The Book of Khalid.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/ameen-rihani/the-book-of-khalid

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Ameen Rihani, author, died 1940 (Wikidata Q471451, death 1940-09-13).

First publication of the text used: 1911, in New York: Dodd, Mead and Company. SE colophon: 'The Book of Khalid was published in 1911 by Ameen Rihani.' Wikipedia (The Book of Khalid): the publisher was Dodd, Mead and Company, and the manuscript was sent to publishers in New York in 1911.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1911, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin (United States): the country of first publication is the United States and the text was first published there before 1931, so the US rule settles the origin too, whatever Rihani's death year.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
